findings: preferred.pointer indirection: awtomatikong pag-dereference ng pointer narrows the term to implicit dereferencing. In the English source, methods/6 describes implicit address-taking (v.Scale(5) interpreted as (&v).Scale(5)), whereas methods/7 describes implicit dereferencing (p.Abs() interpreted as (*p).Abs()). The same glossary term must cover both directions without a false technical claim. Return to the original Generation session for glossary revision; no reviewer replacement.
